records.purpose: Deliver cross-domain reminders through push, SMS and email.
records.scope: Adds the explicit cross-domain medicine, appointment, vaccination, laboratory, travel and AI recommendation routing matrix to the existing channel/template lifecycle.
records.workflow: Receive versioned event → verify origin and recipient scope → resolve template and redaction → schedule idempotently → deliver with bounded retry/expiry → record delivery separately from acknowledgement or clinical response.
inputs: Versioned origin event and authority
Recipient, tenant, purpose and permission context
Channel, template, locale and scheduling constraints
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject stale, revoked, misrouted or duplicate events; invalidate pending delivery on event correction. Expired or unavailable delivery is explicit. Critical escalation follows an authorized domain-owned fallback, never assumed successful from a delivery receipt.
records.acceptance: Every nonempty source line resolves to a canonical anchor. Verify wrong recipient, revoked authority, duplicate/out-of-order events, channel failure, stale origin decision, preview disclosure and sent/read/acknowledged separation; runtime evidence remains outstanding.
records.open_gates: Exact integration contracts, clinical criticality/escalation policy, jurisdictional scheduling authority, privacy/security execution evidence and end-to-end acceptance remain open.
